title: Make the collection announcement span two columns
goal: Arrange a general announcement and keep two side-by-side cards of route and equipment below it.
summary: grid-column specifies the range occupied by grid items in the column direction. span 2 means spanning two columns, 1 / -1 means extending from the first column line to the last column line.
tasks: Use the existing two-column .route-board grid and have .route-notice span both columns.
Check whether the route and equipment cards are arranged in the next row together, with the route on the left and the equipment on the right.

example.note: Today's specials on the food truck menu can fill two columns, and the following regular dishes are filled in each column in sequence.

hint: When the announcement only covers the current cell, try to set grid-column: span 2 for the grid item. width: 100% will only fill the range assigned to it.
